thread:
mina: Hey team — heads up: my EAD expires Nov 2 and I have an H-1B transfer pending. Offer start is Nov 15. Biometrics appointment is Nov 8 but consulate stamping might push into December. Quick Qs: can benefits be backdated if approval is after start? can I do onboarding-only until docs are final?

ella (People Ops): Short: benefits require active payroll + completed I-9. Retroactive enrollment is possible only if immigration docs arrive before payroll cutoff and legal signs off. Otherwise benefits start when payroll begins.

marco (Recruiter): We can set up onboarding-only access (Slack, LMS, internal docs) on Nov 15 if you want to start ramping. Hardware is manager approval.

mina: Good — prefer onboarding-only. Will that let me sign equity and acceptance now?

ella (People Ops): Yes — you can sign offer and equity. Vesting uses official hire date which we can align with payroll start subject to legal.

legal-team: Note: if you have cap-gap or auto-extension, upload the I-797C receipt showing extension language. That can allow payroll to start while petition is pending. Otherwise remote I-9 can use scanned approval PDFs but originals must be inspected by an authorized rep later.

mina: Can Redwood accept consular approval PDF + I-797 for temporary payroll processing?

payroll-bot: Payroll cutoff is the 25th of each month. If docs are received and verified before cutoff, retroactive payroll/hire-date adjustments may be possible pending legal approval.

ella (People Ops): Action items: @mina upload passport + receipt/approval to candidate portal; @marco coordinate manager laptop signoff if needed; legal will review cap-gap eligibility. We'll set onboarding-only for Nov 15 pending docs.

mina: Uploaded passport and receipt — thanks everyone :pray:

marco (Recruiter): Ill request IT for soft access on Nov 15. If you need a laptop earlier, please confirm with your manager and we'll process as an asset loan.

ella (People Ops): Ill DM the consulate travel letter template and the authorized-representative form. Well hold payroll until I-9 originals are inspected or cap-gap docs are accepted. Will update thread after legal reply.
